mf(ई)n. (only sg. and pl.; according to Hara-datta also du. See Siddh. vol. i, p. 98) both, of both kinds, in both ways, in both manners, RV.; AV.; TS.; ŚBr.; AitĀr.; Mn. &c.
1. उभया॑ ind. in both ways, RV. x, 108, 6.
2. उभया (in comp. for उभय above).
